decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses
a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the reticular dermis and subcutis
response.rationale: R3 and C1 share the same core raw evidence: retroperitoneal masses and a skin biopsy showing atypical mononuclear cells. R3 additionally provides a shorter overlapping span of the biopsy finding and a contradict span ruling out cellulitis, which C1 lacks. C1 is an append-only completion of R3 with no new raw support, making R3 more complete and better supported.

rejected.why: Append-only completion of R3 with no additional raw support spans; its evidence is a strict subset of R3's, and it lacks the contradict span that strengthens R3's polarity.
